glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 亻 (= 人) (“person”) + phonetic 門.
senses: [men] Suffix indicating plural for pronouns, some animated nouns and personifications.
[men] Suffix attached to the name of the representative of a group to refer to that whole group.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 們; s_page_origin explains the simplified 们.
